# contradicts claim

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:contradictsClaim`](gmeow-contradictsClaim.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/contradictsClaim>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a contradiction to one of the claim nodes in conflict — at least two per contradiction (SHACL; the OWL existential documents the relator's relata for the reasoner). The range is intentionally open: a claim node is a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md), another [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md), or an RDF 1.2 statement reifier, and a range assertion would leak one form's typing onto the others (the [`tenurePosition`](gmeow-tenurePosition.md) precedent, standpoint slice).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:contradictsClaim`](gmeow-contradictsClaim.md) from [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) to each claim node in conflict — at least two, since a contradiction needs both sides to be a conflict.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting a range on it (the range is left open so it admits [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md), other Observations, and RDF 1.2 statement reifiers alike) and avoid binding only one claim — the SHACL shape requires at least two.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:contradictsClaim`](gmeow-contradictsClaim.md) from the [`Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) to two or more claim nodes of any form; the OWL existential documents the relata for the reasoner while SHACL enforces the minimum of two.

### Examples

- ex:conflict1 [`gmeow:contradictsClaim`](gmeow-contradictsClaim.md) ex:claimA, ex:claimB.
